title: Hopf bifurcation and periodic solutions in a sustainable supply chain defined by a planar system of ordinary differential equations
summary: We analyze the stability of the equilibria and bifurcations of a planar system of ordinary differential equations describing the product-resource interaction in a sustainable supply chain. While periodic behavior in supply chain models has often been documented either in systems of higher dimensions or in delayed systems, here a Hopf bifurcation arises in a planar and delay-free system.
